Summary of needs
- Primary use: customer support chat (LM-driven responses, tool calling for ticket lookup)
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search across KB and reranking of suggested articles
- Traffic profile: expected ramp over 6 months, with heavy peak during product launches

Customer-reported volumes (from call)
- Monthly MAU: ~350k active users
- Active sessions/day: ~45k (average session length 12 turns)
- Average tokens/turn (prompt+reply): chat = 450 tokens, embeddings = 768 tokens/vector, rerank = 120 tokens/query

Immediate qualification questions we flagged
1) Desired price target: you mentioned a target around $800-$1,200 per 1M tokens for the chat mix — can you confirm if that is overall blended or chat-only?
2) Budget band for year 1 (commit or pay-as-you-go)?
3) Per-model split expectation (chat vs embeddings vs rerank) once at steady-state — even rough percentages help us propose the right model mix and quantization.

Next steps (from Redwood)
- I'll send a preliminary pricing estimate + assumptions for model mix and unit economics (attached).
- SE follow-up to validate latency & rerank throughput (cc: Dev).
- If numbers look reasonable, schedule a procurement & security sync next week.

Thanks, looking forward to your clarifications so we can get a tailored proposal together.

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) The $800-$1,200 per 1M token target was a rough internal target for chat-heavy traffic only. For embeddings and rerank we expect much lower per-token willingness to pay — embeddings historically are budgeted at $250-$400 per 1M "embedding tokens" equivalent.

2) Budgeting approach: likely a hybrid. We want a committed baseline for predictable cost (monthly reservation) with the ability to burst (PAYG) during spikes. Tentative FY1 annual budget allocated to this project: $460k-$720k (we're still finalizing).

3) Model mix — ballpark steady-state split we discussed on call: chat 70%, embeddings 20%, rerank 10% (by token volume). Note that embeddings are large vector tokens but relatively fewer requests; we can share expected vectors/day if helpful.

Can you confirm what blended $/1M token you used in the attached estimate and the assumed quantization / model family (e.g., chat: open-chat-v2 q4_0, embeddings: embed-large-v1 q8_0)? Also curious about fallbacks / lower-cost variants if we hit budget constraints.

If possible, can we get a short price scenario for: (A) conservative (lower bound budget), (B) expected, (C) aggressive (full ramp)? We're aiming to present this to procurement next Friday.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Senior Product Manager | BrightLayer
alex.johnson@brightlayer.com

Alex — great details, thank you. Below is the pricing scenario table summary and the key assumptions we used (pulled from the attached workbook):

Assumptions (steady-state)
- Model choices (chat / embeddings / rerank):
  - chat: redwood-chat-v2 (production) with q4_0 quantization for cost-optimized low-latency responses
  - embeddings: redwood-embed-large-v1 with q8_0 quantization (higher precision for semantic search)
  - rerank: redwood-rerank-v1 optimized for throughput (q4_0)
- Typical prompt/response tokens used: chat = 450 tokens/turn; embeddings = 768 tokens/vector; rerank = 120 tokens/query
- Model mix by token volume (steady-state): chat 68%, embeddings 22%, rerank 10%
- Prefix caching estimated to reduce chat prompt tokens by ~12% on average (depends on query patterns)

Pricing scenarios (blended $/1M tokens) — output is blended across model mix and quantization assumptions:
- Conservative: $1,050 per 1M tokens (assumes conservative model selection and 10% additional overhead for burst capacity)
- Expected: $890 per 1M tokens (assumes q4_0 for chat, q8_0 for embeddings, and steady caching improvements)
- Aggressive: $720 per 1M tokens (assumes longer cache hits, heavier use of lower-cost chat variants during non-critical flows)

Year 1 spend estimate (based on your FY1 range and our steady-state assumptions)
- If BrightLayer chooses pay-as-you-go and hits the mid-point of your FY1 ramp (~$590k budget): expected blended unit costs align with the Expected scenario (~$890 / 1M tokens)
- For a 20% committed discount (reserved capacity), the Expected scenario drops to ~$712 / 1M tokens

Attachments included: BrightLayer_Redwood_Pricing_Estimate.xlsx (tab: scenarios, tab: per-model unit costs, tab: assumptions)

Fallbacks & model variants
- We recommend setting routing policies to prefer redwood-chat-v2 for interactive flows; if budget pressure appears in the month we can automatically route non-essential flows to redwood-chat-lite-v1 (lower cost, slightly higher latency / quality tradeoff).

Next steps
- Dev (hey @Dev) — can you validate the rerank throughput and any specialized latency requirements for the rerank pipeline?
- Alex / Priya — can you confirm FY1 committed discount target (if any) and preferred cadence for procurement sync?

If this looks good I can convert the attached into an SOW draft and include a 30-day onboarding plan.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
